headline: US House counsel denies backing federal raid on home of Ilhan Omar
label: NEWS
caption:
A major legal dispute has erupted in Washington over a controversial federal raid. 🏛️

According to Al Jazeera, the US House of General Counsel has accused federal prosecutors of wrongly claiming that the chamber supported an October 12 raid on the home of Representative Ilhan Omar.

Matthew Berry, the top lawyer for the House, stated that federal claims suggesting his office backed the operation or agreed that constitutional protections do not apply to a private residence are categorically false.

Court documents show that US Magistrate Judge Matthew Sharbaugh rejected federal assertions regarding the constitutional protections, ordering that Omar must be given the chance to assert privilege over seized items.

The Trump administration is investigating Omar over alleged immigration fraud, while Democratic lawmakers have strongly condemned the raid as a dangerous intrusion and violation of constitutional separation of powers.

Should congressional homes be protected from such federal raids? 👇
